basic_info.description: This beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home combines classic charm with modern convenience. The formal entry leads to a spacious living room and formal dining room. The kitchen features contemporary cabinets, a large center island, quartz countertops, tiled backsplash and large skylight. High-end stainless steel appliances include a 6-burner stove, vent hood, dishwasher and wine cooler. Upstairs primary suite and bedroom access a view deck and downstairs comes complete with a family room, two additional bedrooms, a full bathroom, and a storage/wine cellar. The backyard features a wooden patio, fruit trees, flowers, and a storage shed. Oversized garage includes extra storage space, a laundry area, and built-in cabinets. A move-in-ready home with thoughtful upgrades throughout!
